name: landNFT permissionless whitelisted minter
summary: The NFT owner whitelisted a helper whose public batch mint forwards arbitrary recipients and quantities without caller authorization. An unrelated caller minted 876 NFTs in five transactions and redeemed 143 for 28,600 XQJ.
notes: The landNFT owner granted the helper the miner role nine blocks after the helper's deployment; without the grant the forwarded mint reverts, so the grant is the latest reset.

143 redemptions removed 28,600 XQJ from the land-for-XQJ exchange 0xeab03ad7; the attacker sold 28,601 XQJ for Binance-Peg USDT in the disposal transaction in refs, and the loss applies that unit value to the 28,600 stolen XQJ only. Unredeemed NFTs carry no value.

The four further batch mints by the same sender are campaign; a later call from 0x3212acc3 minted nothing because MAX_SUPPLY was reached. The 143 redemptions (the attacker's 0x2c672a34 calls to 0xeab03ad7, blocks 28207945-28208116) are the realisation, not exercises of the defect.
